source_title: NASA’s Hubble Views Ocean of Stars in Groundwork for Roman
source_excerpt: These Hubble observations are part of a survey that will help researchers better interpret upcoming Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope observations as they seek to characterize the stars and search for exoplanets in this busy region of our galaxy.
